title: Fulfillment Method
description: A fulfillment method (delivery or pickup) with a destination and options.

type.description: Fulfillment method type. Well-known values: `delivery`, `pickup`. Businesses MAY use additional values via negotiated extensions; Businesses MUST reject unrecognized request values with a recoverable error.

destination.description: The destination for fulfillment. For delivery: customer address. For pickup: food establishment location.

requested_fulfillment_time.description: Platform-requested target fulfillment time as an RFC 3339 timestamp used as a slot-discovery query input. When omitted, the business MUST interpret the request as ASAP fulfillment. When present, the business SHOULD return available fulfillment options matching the requested time, and `selected_option_id` takes precedence once an option is chosen. If the requested time is unavailable, the business SHOULD return a recoverable `fulfillment_time_unavailable` error with available alternatives in the fulfillment options array.

selected_option_id.description: Identifier of the selected fulfillment option.

preference_options.description: Available handoff preferences for this fulfillment method (e.g., drop-off preferences for delivery, or counter vs. curbside handoff for pickup).

selected_preference_option_ids.description: Identifiers of the selected handoff preference options from `preference_options`. Replaces previously submitted selections; send an empty array to clear. In responses, lists only the preferences the Business will honor; rejected selections are omitted and communicated via `messages[]` warnings.

notes.description: Optional input from the buyer for the fulfillment method. Common examples include delivery/pickup instructions.

destination.description: Platform-authored delivery address for this method.
Business-authored location able to fulfill this method. Response-only.
